isolation: Dedicated comparison/.venv; baseline site-packages appended read-only using a .pth file. All pip additions go to comparison/.venv. The original environment and videos are never modified.

dependencies_planned.tensorflow: 2.20.0, separate comparison/.venv-movenet; MoveNet SavedModel CPU inference
dependencies_planned.openvino: 2026.0.0, comparison/.venv; unchanged Sapiens FP32 graph, full heatmap equivalence verified against TorchScript

design.grounding: Original analyze_video emits COCO17 records after ByteTrack, confidence and court-footpoint filtering; render_videos reads these records, calls overlay.annotate_frame, and verifies H264 frame counts. Reuse overlay but not the two-video renderer to avoid unnecessary double renders.
design.usage: Windows PowerShell: .\comparison\run_all.ps1. One method: .\comparison\.venv\Scripts\python.exe comparison\run.py METHOD. MoveNet uses .\comparison\.venv-movenet\Scripts\python.exe. Repeat to resume. comparison\run.py gallery rebuilds only the gallery. comparison\verify_gallery.py validates all videos and creates the portable ZIP.
design.shape: One adapter returns original-frame player records for each decoded image. One runner journals each frame, checkpoints final JSON, renders H264 once, verifies it, and updates manifest/gallery. Top-down adapters reuse existing observed detector boxes, never prior poses.
alternatives: Independent scripts per model: rejected because duplicated frame decoding, coordinate normalization and completion validation can drift.
One incremental runner plus narrow model adapters: selected because model-specific preprocessing is hidden but shared record/validation policy has one owner.
design.synthesis: Use the second shape, borrowing independent subprocess execution from the first to release heavy model memory between runs. No orchestration framework, no dependency changes to the baseline.
design.tradeoffs: Top-down comparisons share full-frame detections acquired before the 0.25 display cutoff plus targeted far-court retry detections. This is not a ground-truth detector. Untracked methods use unknown IDs rather than claiming identity. Individual model confidence scores are not calibrated against one another.

windows_setup.baseline: Never pip-install into the original .venv. Create comparison/.venv, append the absolute original .venv/Lib/site-packages path using baseline-readonly.pth, then install comparison/requirements.txt and requirements-sapiens.txt.
windows_setup.movenet: Create comparison/.venv-movenet without inheriting baseline packages. Install requirements-movenet.txt. TensorFlow's optional header paths exceed MAX_PATH at this deep workspace location; installation succeeded via temporary subst Q: pointing to comparison. Runtime can use the normal interpreter path.
windows_setup.openvino: The configured feed returned 404 for PEP658 metadata. pip install --use-deprecated=legacy-resolver -r comparison/requirements-sapiens.txt fetched the actual public wheel successfully. No TLS verification was disabled.
windows_setup.sapiens: Run comparison/sapiens_portable.py once before Sapiens to create/verify the exact OpenVINO graph. The adapter otherwise uses original TorchScript CPU. Official COCO17 weights returned gated-repository401; used public official Goliath308 weights instead and labeled/mapped them explicitly.
windows_setup.prefetch: All checkpoints were downloaded separately before full inference. Asset hashes and model URLs are recorded. Initial prefetch elapsed times were not instrumented; they are not included in model inference timings.

resume_policy: Completed JSON and verified videos are reused. Stateless and temporal fresh-pose adapters resume per-frame JSONL journals. YOLO and MediaPipe tracker state is not reconstructed from old poses; interrupted tracker runs restart. Acquisition revision and SHA invalidate stale top-down results, preserving superseded comparison attempts under comparison/attempts.
timing_policy: Single-run elapsed processing, not a general speed benchmark. Model initialization/checkpoint loading, fresh-pose inference, common detector acquisition, rendering, graph conversion and independent downloads are separated. Retrying a partial stateless journal uses recorded progress timing; no accuracy ranking.
